constraints: Evaluate the complete current contexts appended after the diff; they include code that predates the review base. Evidence ownership must never expose a materialized accepted blob to GC before terminal publication.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm all prior findings are resolved and report any remaining critical correctness or evidence-durability defect. Materialized CLI blobs must atomically transfer from upload pins to request-hash pins under the CAS operation lock. Direct grant-pending requests may reference absent blobs, but any materialized blob must stay pinned. Terminal records without receipts must preserve request ownership. Receipt pins must precede terminal publication, failed commits must roll them back, and cleanup failures must preserve original HTTP/domain status.
